proposals.name: Micro-Museums & Local Heritage Associations (France)
proposals.buyer_persona: Volunteer curators or local tourism office managers in French villages seeking cheap, high-quality local souvenir merchandise to fund their historic sites.
product_angles: Custom historic coloring pages of specific local ruins/castles
Print-on-demand postcards featuring localized vector heraldry/crests
Historical site guidebooks with low-content activity pages for visiting kids
proposals.first_test_product: A 16-page custom coloring booklet for a specific French medieval ruin (e.g., Chateau de Coucy or local equivalent) sold directly via cold-emailing their association.

proposals.name: Ham Radio Operators (Amateur Radio & SWL)
proposals.buyer_persona: Tech-savvy hobbyists (mainly older men but growing youth niche) obsessed with long-distance radio communication, signal tracing, and custom QSL confirmation cards.
product_angles: Specialized radio contact logbooks optimized for field operations (POTA/SOTA)
Humorous schematics and 'Radio Shack' warning signs for wall decor
proposals.first_test_product: A dedicated POTA (Parks on the Air) Logbook with custom tables for signal reports, weather, and antenna setups, published on Amazon KDP.

proposals.name: Orthophonistes / Speech-Language Pathologists (SLPs)
proposals.buyer_persona: Speech therapists in France and Belgium looking for modern, engaging, and aesthetically pleasing physical card games and tracking sheets to use during therapy sessions with children.
product_angles: Phoneme-specific minimal illustration card games for articulation therapy
Visual progress-tracking sticker charts and session logs
Speech therapy room decor prints featuring phonetic alphabets in pastel tones
proposals.first_test_product: A printable 54-card deck focusing on the difficult French sounds 'ch/j' with custom vector illustrations, sold on Etsy as a digital PDF download.

proposals.name: Retro 1-Bit Indie Game Developers (Pico-8 & GB Studio)
proposals.buyer_persona: Solo game developers participating in game jams (like Ludum Dare or itch.io jams) who need fast, cohesive, high-contrast 1-bit retro assets.
product_angles: 1-Bit retro UI/UX asset packs (buttons, borders, icons) formatted for Godot
Pico-8 style fantasy tilesets and character sprites (16x16 or 8x8)
Modular card templates for physical prototyping of indie digital games
proposals.first_test_product: A '1-Bit Cyberpunk Interface Pack' containing 200+ micro-icons and UI elements in transparent PNG format, uploaded to itch.io and Cults3D.

proposals.name: Geocaching Enthusiasts
proposals.buyer_persona: Outdoor adventurers who search for hidden containers globally, needing compact logbook refills, stealth containers, and trackable designs.
proposals.first_test_product: A set of 5 parametric, threaded, waterproof micro-containers (bison tube style) designed in OpenSCAD, listed on Cults3D.

proposals.name: Balcony Permaculture & Micro-Homesteading
proposals.buyer_persona: Urban renters wanting to maximize vegetable yield on tiny balconies or windowsills using organic companion planting and vertical setups.
product_angles: Urban garden planners with container size and soil depth calculators
Companion planting visual wheels (SVG templates for local printing)
Minimalist modern seed packet envelopes with crop-specific care guides
proposals.first_test_product: A 'Balcony Garden Companion & Logbook' detailing crop matching, pot volume requirements, and weekly watering/fertilizing schedules.
